camel_example: aliyun esa CreateSiteDeliveryTask --region cn-hangzhou --SlsDelivery '{"SLSProject":"dcdn-test20240417","SLSRegion":"cn-hangzhou","SLSLogStore":"accesslog-test"}' --SiteId 12312312112000 --HttpDelivery '{"Compress":"gzip","LogSplit":true,"LogBodySuffix":"cdnVersion:1.0","HeaderParam":{"key":"example-string"},"StandardAuthParam":{"PrivateKey":"000","UrlPath":"v1/log/upload","ExpiredTime":300},"StandardAuthOn":true,"DestUrl":"http://xxx.aliyun.com/v1/log/upload","MaxBatchSize":1000,"MaxRetry":3,"MaxBatchMB":5,"LogBodyPrefix":"cdnVersion:1.0","QueryParam":{"key":"example-string"},"LastLogSplit":true,"TransformTimeout":10,"LogSplitWords":"example-string"}' --FilterVer 'example-string' --DiscardRate '0.0' --BusinessType dcdn_log_access_l1 --DataCenter cn --TaskName 'dcdn-test-task' --S3Delivery '{"SecretKey":"LDSIKh000","Endpoint":"https://s3.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com","VertifyType":"example-string","Region":"cn-beijing","BucketPath":"logriver-test/log","ServerSideEncryption":true,"AccessKey":"yourAccessKeyID","PrefixPath":"logriver-test/log","S3Cmpt":true}' --KafkaDelivery '{"Compress":"lz4","UserName":"xxx","MachanismType":"plain","Brokers":["192.168.xxx.xxx:9902"],"Balancer":"kafka.LeastBytes","Topic":"dqc_test2","UserAuth":true,"Password":"000"}' --FieldName 'user_agent,ip_adress,ip_port' --OssDelivery '{"BucketName":"test_rlog","Region":"cn-shanghai","PrefixPath":"test/","Aliuid":"1234000"}' --DeliveryType sls
